cards.card_text: Merab bore them to Adriel son of Barzillai the Meholathite.
cards.verse_text: But the king took Armoni and Mephibosheth, the two sons whom Rizpah daughter of Aiah had borne to Saul, as well as the five sons whom Merab daughter of Saul had borne to Adriel son of Barzillai the Meholathite.
cards.snippet: …Merab daughter of Saul had borne to Adriel son of Barzillai the Meholathite.
